title: Law requiring study of youth fights linked to online activity
summary: This bill would direct the Department of Youth and Community Development, working with the Mayor's Office for Neighborhood Safety and Gun Violence Prevention, to study in-person fights among people under 24 who attend department-funded programs and any related online activity that led to them. Within six months of taking effect, the department would have to report findings to the Council Speaker and Mayor, including details of each altercation, related online activity and any agency response, plus strategies to monitor and counsel young people on their online activity. The law would take effect immediately.
